facts.business: Spice Islands Industries Limited operates across Food & Beverages, Hospitality, Electric Vehicle rental, and Edible Oil segments, engaged in food trading and distribution, hotel operations, EV renting/hire services, and planning edible oil manufacturing, processing, refining, and distribution.
key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant management judgement in determining timing of revenue recognition based on transfer of control due to varying terms and conditions with different customers
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Act, where applicable and details of such transactions have been disclosed in the financial statements as required by the applicable accounting standards.
